limitations: Trusted storage primitive only; scope is not authentication. No public data route, lifecycle manager adapter or customer AWS credentials.
Complete app deletion still needs immediate routing/session/runtime/data credential revocation and coordination with S3 files; data restore must not revive old credentials.
No collection listing/query API, S3 file backend, physical purge worker/quota release, backup/restore or IAM/provisioning/live AWS proof yet.
Caller owns the SDK client and must enforce timeouts/retries/global admission; failed and ambiguous requests still cost service capacity.
Complete $10 cost/egress control, wake/idle, UI/tools/WebSockets, full Doctor >=95 and hosted acceptance remain unmet.
